sources.title: Evo 1.5 8k Base - biolm.ai
sources.snippet: Evo 1.5 8k Base Evo 1.5 8k Base is a 7B-parameter autoregressive genomic language model trained on ~300B nucleotides from prokaryotic genomes with 8,192-token context at single-nucleotide resolution.

sources.title: GitHub - evo-design/evo: Biological foundation modeling from molecular ...
sources.snippet: We describe Evo 1.5 in the paper "Semantic design of functional de novo genes from a genomic language model". We used the Evo 1.5 model to generate SynGenome, the first AI-generated genomics database containing over 100 billion base pairs of synthetic DNA sequences.

sources.title: Evo v1.5-8k Base - biolm.ai
sources.snippet: 1.5-B parameter Evo multimodal LM (DNA/RNA) with 8 k context; supports log-prob scoring and sequence generation.
